name: vscode-dataform-tools
description: Dataform Tools - VS Code extension to run and visualise Dataform data pipelines and much more

paragraphs: A VS Code extension for Dataform and dbt™ projects on BigQuery. Officially recommended VS Code extension for Dataform by Google[^1] ✨. Supports Dataform versions 2.9.x and 3.x, dbt Core 1.8 and later, and dbt v2, in all major operating systems. Works in: VS Code, Cursor, Antigravity.
These are pictures. You can click through the real panel, with made-up data, at dataformtools.com.
features: A dash means not in a dbt project yet. Each name links to its description at dataformtools.com/features.
The pictures below are taken from the live demo by just website-demo, of the extension's own panel.
A dry run checks every save against BigQuery, and what it rejects is marked on the line you wrote, listed in Problems and told in the panel.
The hover of a table is the same in a Dataform and a dbt project: its kind, location, description, partition, row count and columns.
Each ${ref()} says whether its table is read from production or is built in dev.
